<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
Executable(backend_executable, signature)
```

Part of [`evoxc.pipeline`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/)

User-facing executable: a backend executable + structured signature.

Wraps a backend-level executable (whose `run` speaks flat tensor lists)
with the Graph's input/output TreeSpecs and static values, so `evoxc.run`
and `evoxc.bind` accept and return ordinary nested Python structures.

## Attributes

- `backend_executable` — the backend executable (satisfies the
  `evoxc.backends.Executable` protocol: `run(flat_inputs) ->
  flat_outputs`, `.functions`, `.device`).

- `signature` — `evoxc.backends.Signature` (input/output TreeSpec +
  per-leaf specs + static values).

## backend

Backend name the executable runs on (e.g. `"numpy"`, `"iree"`).

Delegates to the backend executable's `backend_name` class
attribute (declared by every in-tree backend) — used by `evoxc.run`
for run-stage option/env resolution.

## device

Device the executable is bound to (delegates to the backend
executable).

## functions

Function names exported by the loaded program (delegates to the
backend executable).

## load

```python
load(path, backend=None, device=None)
```

Load a persisted executable; never silently recompiles.

Opens the evoxc.persist container, requires payload type
`"evoxc.compiled_artifact"` (a lowered program raises
`core.PersistenceError` directing to compile first), resolves the
recorded backend (an explicitly given backend — name or instance —
must match, else `core.PersistenceError`), then reconstructs via
`evoxc.backends.CompiledArtifact.load(path)` + `backend.load(...)`
and re-wraps with the decoded signature. Never re-traces, re-lowers,
or re-compiles.

## plan_text

```python
plan_text()
```

The backend's execution-plan text, or `None` when it has none.

Delegates to the backend executable's optional `plan_text` (the numpy
interpreter implements it — `NumpyExecutable.plan_text` renders the
per-block execution plan). Backends without a textual plan return
`None`, exactly like `CompiledArtifact.source_text()`. Pure
inspection: rendering a plan executes nothing, reads no cached plan,
and populates none. Rendering: `evoxc._inspect.plan_text`.

## save

```python
save(path)
```

Persist the executable if the backend supports it.

Delegates to the backend executable's `save` when it has one.
Backends that cannot serialize device handles must save the
underlying CompiledArtifact and reconstruct on load — never pretend
a device handle was serialized: if the backend executable exposes no
callable `save`, this raises `core.PersistenceError` directing the
user to `artifact.save(path)` + `evoxc.load`.

## summary

```python
summary() -> dict
```

JSON-safe inspection snapshot of this loaded executable.

Pure inspection — reads the wrapper's signature and the backend
executable's already-built metadata only; never traces, compiles,
loads, runs, or populates a cache. Keys:

* `backend` — backend name (or `None`).
* `device` — `str(device)` (or `None`).
* `functions` — function names exported by the loaded program.
* `input_count` / `output_count` — tensor leaf counts, i.e.
  `len(signature.input_specs)` / `len(signature.output_specs)`.
* `input_specs` / `output_specs` — one dict
  `{"shape": [str(dim), ...], "dtype": str, "device": str | None}`
  per tensor leaf, in flat leaf order.
* `input_tree` / `output_tree` — the one-line description of the
  recorded TreeSpec (`None` when absent): `core.describe_node`'s
  wording for containers and static leaves, with tensor leaves
  rendered as `tensor input leaf` / `tensor output leaf` /
  `tensor leaf` instead of a private trace marker class name.
* `static_value_count` — `len(signature.static_values)`.
* `required_ops` — the compiled artifact's `required_custom_ops`
  (`[]` when the backend executable exposes no artifact).
* `capabilities` — the registered backend's `Capabilities` as a
  dict (`dtypes` as `"dtype_count"`; other sets as sorted lists),
  or `None` when the backend cannot be resolved.

A missing signature yields zeroed counts, `None` trees and an empty
`input_specs`/`output_specs` — it never raises.
Rendering: `evoxc._inspect.executable_summary`.

## synchronize

```python
synchronize()
```

Wait until all device work submitted by previous `run()` calls on
this executable has completed.

Binding semantics: the output Tensors' values are already valid before
the call (any read awaits), only their *timing* needs this — so
`synchronize` is an EXPLICIT caller-invoked primitive that lets a
caller overlap dispatch (the default) and join only when it must.
Nothing in evoxc calls it implicitly and `evoxc.run` is unchanged (no
per-call sync — dispatch overlap stays a feature).

Delegates to the backend executable's optional `synchronize` when it
has one; a backend whose `run` already blocks on the device queue
(numpy, iree) is a documented no-op here (numpy exposes no method at
all). Returns `None`.
